en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's burn this place to the ground

Yeah! It's got nothing to do with 
exercising, but your mind's important!

If you can't visualize your goals, 
you'll never be able to achieve them.

That's just what I'd expect from my 
sidekick! You get what's important!

Huh? If you're the referee, does that 
mean I'll just be exercising by myself?

Haha! So the sidekick wants to see 
the hero's full potential?

Then why didn't you say so!?
I'll show you everything I got!
What? Hey, c'mon, that's not you, man.

What's wrong? If something's wrong, 
all you gotta do is talk to me about it.

If it's something you won't talk to me
about, then there's nothing I can do...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaito looks deep in thought...
